name: Buenos Aires
shape: geoBoundaries, the province it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

winkler: Big crops are possible, but quality tops out at acceptable.
